recommendations.headline: Predicted condition: Danger. Tell a maintenance engineer now and follow site safety procedures.

items.action: Notify the responsible maintenance engineer immediately.
items.reason: Danger is the most serious class the model predicts. A qualified person must assess it now.
items.safety_note: If you see signs of an immediate hazard, such as smoke, burning smell, sparks or severe vibration, follow the site's emergency procedure first.
items.source_detail: General guidance. Requires maintenance-engineer confirmation. No site-approved procedure is configured for this action.

items.action: If the equipment may be unsafe to run, stop or isolate it only through the site's approved shutdown, lockout/tagout and authorisation procedures.
items.reason: This system cannot judge whether the equipment is unsafe and does not control the machine. That decision belongs to authorised personnel.
items.safety_note: Do not open electrical equipment, remove guards or touch moving parts unless you are qualified and authorised.
items.source_detail: General guidance. Requires maintenance-engineer confirmation. No site-approved procedure is configured for this action.

items.action: Arrange a qualified inspection before the equipment returns to service, where site procedures require it.
items.reason: A Danger prediction is not a confirmed fault. Only an inspection can confirm or dismiss it.
items.source_detail: General guidance. Requires maintenance-engineer confirmation. No site-approved procedure is configured for this action.

items.action: Record the sensor readings, the model output, the timestamp and every action taken.
items.reason: A complete record supports the investigation and later review.
items.source_detail: General guidance. Requires maintenance-engineer confirmation. No site-approved procedure is configured for this action.

items.action: Check the approved maintenance instructions before deciding on any repair.
items.reason: The model does not identify a mechanical cause. Repairs need a qualified diagnosis.
items.source_detail: General guidance. Requires maintenance-engineer confirmation. No site-approved procedure is configured for this action.

recommendations.summary: Danger: 5 recommended actions. First: Notify the responsible maintenance engineer immediately.
recommendations.disclaimer: This is decision support from a research prototype, not a safety-rated control system. It does not issue shutdown commands and does not diagnose a fault. Site safety procedures and qualified personnel always take precedence.
recommendations.threshold_note: These recommendations follow the model's predicted class only. No approved engineering thresholds are configured, so no sensor value is judged high or low here. Thresholds need approval from a qualified engineer before they can be used.
return_to_service: A qualified person has inspected the motor and recorded what they found.
The reason for the predicted condition has been identified, or ruled out, by that inspection. This system does not identify causes.
Any repair or adjustment was carried out under the approved maintenance procedure and recorded.
A new measurement has been taken after the inspection and entered here, and its predicted condition has been reviewed by the maintenance engineer.
Return to service has been authorised under the site's procedure, including removal of any lockout/tagout by the authorised person.
recommendations.return_to_service_note: These are questions to settle, not pass/fail criteria. This system cannot decide that a motor is safe to return to service. The actual criteria must come from the site's approved procedures, and the decision belongs to authorised, qualified personnel.

interpretation_note: Predicted condition class from a statistical model. It is NOT a confirmed machine failure, and the scores are model outputs, not calibrated probabilities.
